about.title: About us
about.p1: GH Diseños is a company dedicated to the creation and distribution of high-quality mechanical blueprints, made with the most advanced design tools on the market.
about.p2: Our team is made up of engineers and designers with years of experience in the industrial and architectural sector.
about.p3: We work with SolidWorks, AutoCAD, Fusion 360, FreeCAD and other tools, guaranteeing precise, verified blueprints ready for production or construction.
about.value1_desc: Every blueprint is thoroughly reviewed to ensure perfect measurements.
about.value2_desc: We use the latest computer-aided design technologies.
about.value3_desc: We are by your side at every stage of the project.
